name: AI Audio Field
description: A file field whose audio is generated from text by an AI text-to-speech provider, with a widget to write text and generate/regenerate the audio.
project_description: AI Audio Field (the follow-up to the ElevenLabs Field module, now provider-agnostic) provides a file field type whose MP3 audio is generated from text using any of the AI module's text-to-speech providers. The field stores the target file plus the source text, chosen provider, model and provider configuration; its custom widget lets an editor type text, pick a provider and model, adjust provider-specific settings, and Generate/Regenerate the audio inline, with the generated file rendered by core's default file formatter. It also ships two AI Automators rules (for the ai_automators module): 'Generate story', which prompts an LLM to write a multi-voice dialogue and synthesises each line with a per-speaker voice, and 'Merge Audio Files', which concatenates a field's audio files with ffmpeg when ffmpeg is available on the server. Requires the AI module (^1.0.5) and core file, on Drupal 10.2+/11.
